familySummary: Grant is a multicolour rug family in Chenillepolyester, offered in two sizes for living spaces, dining areas or bedrooms.
familyDescription: Grant is a multicolour rug family designed for use in living spaces, dining areas or bedrooms. Its patterned look adds colour to the room, while the two size options make it easier to choose a fit for different layouts. Both rugs are made in Chenillepolyester and have a low profile. The smaller format suits more compact areas, while the larger one works well under a seating group or a dining table.
